videos.title: The Disappearance of Julie Reilly
videos.overview: In March 2018, Julie Reilly was reported missing. The skilled investigators of Police Scotland’s major investigations team take up the case.

videos.title: The Search for Julie Reilly
videos.overview: This episode starts with the interrogation of the number one suspect. With no body, it takes all the detectives' skill to prove the case and charge their suspect.

videos.title: Motive Unknown
videos.overview: Forty-six-year-old Stephen Wallace is found dead in his Paisley home from a number of injuries. The detectives forensically comb the crime scene for clues which will lead them to his killer.
